Hospital Lumen is a modern private hospital known for its natural light, indoor garden, and calm, patient-first approach. In this unit, you play the patient, moving through reception, consultation, and diagnostic areas just like a real visit.

Emergency Medicine
24/7 triage and acute care for sudden symptoms and injuries.
Diagnostic Imaging
MRI, CT, and X-ray, read by an in-house radiology team.
General & Elective Surgery
From routine procedures to more complex operations.
Inpatient Care
Ward beds for recovery and monitoring after treatment.
